correctness.rationale: With the chain prefix closure, each attacking row is governed by its smallest direct target. Direct semantics give the exact counterattack suffix and the equation Def(E_k)=E_{h(h(k))}. Prefix closure, conflict-free constraints and equality with Def yield the two-cycle complete criterion; stable iff h(k)=k. Distinct antitone two-cycles plus at most one fixed point give the sharp bound. Every weakly decreasing h is realized by independent one-attack-or-empty rows, and exact stars-and-bars plus Vandermonde prove the stable census. Direct finite tests: 66,066 fully exhaustive raw relations through n=4, 600 deterministic larger samples, and 17,576 exhaustively enumerated cutoff profiles through n=8; not substitutes for the symbolic proof.
